2609.01564.title: From Confusion to Clarity: Confusion-Aware Retrieval and Knowledge Injection for Text Classification
2609.01564.paper_summary: Large language models (LLMs) struggle to classify text into taxonomies with many semantically similar labels, as the distinctions are domain-specific and not captured by pre-training. To handle large label spaces, a common approach retrieves top-$K$ candidate labels by embedding similarity and prompt the LLM to choose among them. However, top-$K$ retrieval reduces the number of candidates but does not help the model tell similar ones apart. When two similar labels both appear as candidates, the model lacks the signal to choose correctly between them. We propose a framework that (1) identifies which label pairs the model struggles to distinguish, (2) expands the candidate set to include confusable labels, and (3) generates targeted rules to differentiate between similar candidates. The framework requires no fine-tuning, and the generated rules transfer to smaller, cheaper models. On three benchmarks (WOS, Flipkart, LEDGAR), our approach improves Macro F1 by up to 10.0pp over retrieval baselines, with smaller models (2B--20B) gaining up to 11.5pp via cross-model transfer.
2609.01564.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）在將文本分類到具有許多語義相似標籤的分類法中面臨挑戰，因為這些區別是特定於領域的，並未在預訓練中捕捉到。為了處理大型標籤空間，一種常見的方法是通過嵌入相似性檢索前$K$個候選標籤，並提示LLM在其中進行選擇。然而，前$K$的檢索雖然減少了候選者的數量，但並未幫助模型區分相似的標籤。當兩個相似的標籤都作為候選者出現時，模型缺乏正確選擇它們之間的信號。我們提出了一個框架，該框架（1）識別模型難以區分的標籤對，（2）擴展候選集以包括易混淆的標籤，以及（3）生成針對性的規則以區分相似的候選者。該框架不需要微調，生成的規則可轉移到更小、更便宜的模型。在三個基準測試（WOS、Flipkart、LEDGAR）上，我們的方法使宏觀F1提升了最多10.0個百分點，相較於檢索基準，較小的模型（2B--20B）通過跨模型轉移獲得了最多11.5個百分點的提升。
